name: Pipedrive
one_liner: CRM platform offering a RESTful API, Marketplace apps and a Developer Platform.
auth_notes: Personal API token obtained from the Pipedrive app, or an OAuth 2.0 access token for apps. Pages do not state the OAuth flow type or token lifetime.
access_notes: Every Pipedrive plan includes an API token for free, per Pipedrive pages. Sandbox requires a separate account request. Plan prices not on fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Free API token on every plan, documented RESTful v1 API with OAuth 2.0 for apps, and a sandbox option. No app review or paid-tier gate is stated on the fetched pages.

identity.quote: Our open API (or Application Programming Interface) and Developer Platform give you the opportunity to integrate and optimize the tools you need

auth.quote: Access to the Pipedrive API is only possible using the API key or an access token when using OAuth 2.0.

access.quote: Every Pipedrive plan comes with an API token that gives you access to our RESTful API for free.

sandbox.quote: To test your applications, we recommend creating a new, separate Pipedrive account for sandboxing purposes.

api_surface.quote: Within our powerful and flexible API is our extensive API Reference with hundreds of endpoints.

needs_human_reason: Official MCP server status is not verifiable from the fetched pages (the PyPI page did not render). Search results mention one, but it is unconfirmed.
